summary: Ubuntu 18.10 (Cosmic Cuttlefish) was released on 18 October 2018. Features: GNOME 3.30, improved fractional scaling for HiDPI, Yaru theme refinements. The cuttlefish can change color and shape—symbolizing the evolving Ubuntu experience. Minor release with focus on polish.
notes: Unsupported since 2019-07-18. Kernel 4.18. Part of the post-Unity GNOME stabilization period.
